grh_689553c689c73d7649db.title: The Long Night
paragraphs: Cleaning woman Anna Kauffman, security guard Ernie Mottrano, and young office worker Bonnie Albus are trapped overnight in a stalled elevator. With no immediate way out, Anna tells how she survived Auschwitz, Ernie admits that guilt from Vietnam has poisoned his life, and Bonnie confesses that as a lonely college student she briefly lived with a violent cult led by a man later exposed as a mass murderer. Anna insists that remembering evil must be joined by forgiveness, forgiving Ernie and urging him to forgive himself; the three emerge from the night changed enough that, when help finally arrives, they choose to wait and leave the elevator together.

grh_68d6a0301552e82fed78.title: And Baby Makes Four
paragraphs: After nearly ten years of marriage, Joe and Elizabeth Bentley separate just as a five-year-old Vietnamese-American boy named Joey is about to arrive through an adoption arrangement they began together. Although their marriage appears finished, neither can bear to abandon the child, so they agree to continue with the adoption long enough to give him a home. Joey quickly bonds with both of them and turns their planned separation into an increasingly absurd argument over which parent would get custody. By the time Joe and Elizabeth admit they still want each other, Elizabeth has one more surprise: she is pregnant, making their repaired family four.
